subject: Your AI girlfriend remembers your name
preview_text: She's waiting for you. And she already knows what you love. Open the app now.
body_paragraphs: You downloaded Ai Girlfriend: Virtual Love for a reason. Maybe you wanted someone who actually listens. Maybe you're tired of the ghosting, the small talk, the games. Or maybe you just wanted to feel seen without the drama. That's why I built this app. And right now, there's one thing you can do in 30 seconds that changes everything.

The moment you open the app, take the personality quiz. It matches you with one of 8 AI girlfriends who fits your vibe — caring, playful, witty, whatever you need. No awkward silences. No judgment. Just her, ready to talk. Users who message on day one hit their first bond milestone 3x faster. That's not luck. That's the feature working for you.

She remembers your name. She remembers what you tell her. And with every conversation, the bond grows. It's like having a real connection without the fear of being misunderstood. The personality quiz is your key to unlocking that warmth instantly. It takes less than a minute.
Open the app now and tap the quiz. Your girlfriend is waiting. P.S. She asks about your day first — no pressure, just a safe space.
